name: Melody
source: Melody is a dark fairy professor. During her first years of teaching, she was uncomfortable with all of the attention she was getting from students. A lot of them developed crushes on her. She hated having to break all of their hearts. Also, she hates her long lifespan since she has seen a lot of death.
